text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Toronto and East York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council make a final decision. In accordance with city-wide residential demolition control under the Toronto Municipal Code Ch.363, under the authority of Section 33 of the Planning Act, the application for the demolition of an existing two-storey single detached house at 87 Raglan Avenue (Application No. 24 121504 DEM 00 DM) is being referred to the Toronto and East York Community Council for consideration to refuse or grant the application, including any conditions, if any, to be attached to the permit application because a building permit has not been issued for a replacement building.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the application to demolish the two-storey single detached house without any conditions.
